newsitem.title: UK: UK's P&I Club orders 5 pct rise in premium ratings.
newsitem.headline: UK's P&I Club orders 5 pct rise in premium ratings.

text.p: The UK's protection and indemnity (P&I) club, which insures over one fifth of the world's merchant shipping fleet, has ordered a five percent increase in premium ratings for the 1997 policy year.

"Growth in world trade and other economic factors mean that the club should plan for an upward trend in claims in the coming year," said a statement from the UK P&I Club on Thursday. The premium increase is to be implemented from February 20.
Separately, the club has agreed that a limit of $4 billion be the optimum level for claims other than oil pollution.
